shortDescription: Run the VSX provisioning tool with the specified parameters.

options.name: add_physical_interface_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to add a physical interface to a VSX gateway or VSX Cluster.

options.name: add_route_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to add a route to a Virtual System or Virtual Router.

options.name: add_vd_interface_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to add a new interface to a Virtual Device.

options.name: add_vd_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to add a new Virtual Device (VS/VSB/VSW/VR).

options.name: add_vsx_cluster_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to add a new VSX Cluster.

options.name: add_vsx_gateway_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to add a new VSX Gateway.

options.name: attach_bridge_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to attach a new bridge interface to a Virtual System.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: operation
options.description:
The name of the provisioning operation to run. Each operation has its own specific parameters.
The available operations are,
  • add-vsx-gateway - Adds a new VSX gateway
  • add-vsx-cluster - Adds a new VSX cluster*
  • add-vsx-cluster-member - Adds a new VSX cluster member*
  • add-vd - Adds a new Virtual Device (VS/VSB/VSW/VR) to a VSX gateway or VSX cluster
  • add-vd-interface - Adds a new virtual interface to a Virtual Device

options.name: remove_physical_interface_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a physical interface from a VSX (Gateway or Cluster).

options.name: remove_route_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a route from a Virtual System or Virtual Router.

options.name: remove_vd_interface_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a logical interface from a Virtual Device.

options.name: remove_vd_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a Virtual Device.

options.name: remove_vsx_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster.

options.name: set_physical_interface_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to change the configuration of a physical interface.

options.name: set_vd_interface_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to change the configuration of a logical interface.

options.name: set_vd_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to change the configuration of a Virtual Device.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
